authority: Explicit user requirement: eligible provider genre before AI fallback; existing local decisions and explicit cleanup remain authoritative
assistance: disabled explicitly for every process; fallback accuracy and requests are uncovered, zero grounded-assistance accuracy credit
genre: Retain nonblank per-file local genre unless explicit cleanup is requested
Retain selected eligible provider genre, otherwise use compatible provider donor evidence before optional inference
Provider disagreement is not absence and does not authorize AI adjudication
A provider field receipt must match the actual fetched frozen response and readback and survive reopening worker state
Certify a source independently from reviewed artist and album identity, full one-to-one unchanged reviewed title/version mapping and duration compatibility
Unknown source eligibility is an audit finding, not permission to weaken the reviewed mapping
No donor genre does not imply that scripted or live assistance was evaluated
credits: Preserve unchanged reviewed performer expectations; a compatible fetched donor may supplement selected credits without replacing selected edition identity; non-nested disagreements must hold
identity: Preserve explicit selected release identity for resolved output; content-only output cannot acquire release or recording IDs
review: Content-only and assisted output retain persisted pending review; acknowledgment does not verify inference or authorize an unsupported write
integrity: Every physical file is bound to its input; payload hashes remain identical; held and cancelled files retain full bytes and tags
limits: Inspected development cases, silent FLACs and frozen providers. Explicit cleanup and assistance failures/cancellation are covered only by the retained separate safety cycle. No acoustic/mastering, live-agent, transport-recovery, or packaged-UI claim.
